name: commandk
description: Keyboard-first command palette for Chrome and Firefox: tabs, history, bookmarks, actions, and a calculator.

scripts.run:firefox: pnpm run build && pnpm dlx web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.package:firefox: pnpm run build && pnpm dlx web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist
scripts.sign:firefox: pnpm run build && pnpm dlx web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --channel unlisted --api-key "$AMO_API_KEY" --api-secret "$AMO_API_SECRET" --artifacts-dir dist
